data.title: AI Risk Is 'Moving Somewhere Harder to See': Citigroup, JPMorgan Reportedly Look to Offload AI Debt as Investors Grow Wary of Buildout
data.description: Banks have reportedly put AI-related loans on the market to shed risk or lend more, as investor appetite for the debt buildout is tested.

data.title: ‘Precooked Recipe for War’: Iran’s Abbas Araghchi Questions Kuwait Attack That Killed 2 Italians as EU Seeks More Pressure on Tehran
data.description: Iran questioned its alleged role in a Kuwait drone attack that killed two Italian nationals, warning it could provoke a wider war.

data.title: ‘Sore Subject’ for the Thanksgiving Table: Peter Schiff Says Bitcoin Fall Leaves Holders With Little to Celebrate
data.description: Economist Peter Schiff said on Thursday. November 26, that Bitcoin holders may have little to celebrate this Thanksgiving after the cryptocurrency’s sharp year-over-year decline.

data.title: Trump Says Putin 'Certainly Can' Attend G20 Summit in Florida: 'I'd Like to Have Him'
